cause_quote: The added `if (!ancestors.has(1)) { throw new ServiceInspectionError("service-ancestry-unverified"); }` rejected the restart even after native membership returned `outside`.
user_saw: From an external macOS terminal with an unreadable ancestor, `openclaw gateway restart` failed with “Process ancestry could not be fully inspected.”
summary: The fix lets macOS gateway restarts proceed when native launchd membership verifies that the caller is outside the Gateway job.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit’s parent and confirmed that a terminal without matching service markers reached the direct restart path when its partial ancestry omitted the Gateway PID. The causing diff added native membership detection but let `outside` fall through to the new PID 1 requirement, so the same restart could now fail before reaching `launchctl kickstart`.
